# FLX-7010: seam credibility gate not met

**Family:** calibration (the 7000 band)

A Simulation.spec.emits[] entry declares minCredibility, but no Playback scorecard bound to the referenced worldRef reports at least that credibility (FLUX RFC-05; mirrors flux_spec.validate's offline check). Author a Playback with a higher scorecard.credibility, lower the declared minCredibility, or remove the gate.

## Look it up offline

```console
$ fluxsim explain FLX-7010
```

Every code is listed in the [error index](./README.md).
